mapper.sql: select fulfillment_item_id, fulfillment_id, order_item_id, quantity, created_at from fulfillment_items
mapper.select: where fulfillment_id = #{fulfillmentId} order by fulfillment_item_id asc

select fi.fulfillment_item_id, fi.fulfillment_id, fi.order_item_id, fi.quantity, fi.created_at from fulfillment_items fi inner join fulfillment_orders fo on fi.fulfillment_id = fo.fulfillment_id where fo.order_id = #{orderId} order by fi.fulfillment_item_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into fulfillment_items ( fulfillment_id, order_item_id, quantity, created_at ) values ( #{fulfillmentId}, #{orderItemId}, #{quantity}, sysdate() )
